name: chevron-left-right
description: Opposing rounded chevrons for left and right.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner explicitly requested larger native None glyphs while retaining the existing smaller Square/Circle glyphs unchanged. Opposed Chevron None uniformly scales its original centerlines by73/44 about12,12, with20px visible primary extent at Regular1.75. Head shapes and opposing placement retain their proportions; Left Right is a rigid quarter-turn. None geometry is authored separately from frames, with no runtime style/frame scaling and no scaling of stroke width. Rebuild all Filled contours at the fixed source stroke expansion; never scale a previous Filled path. Square/Circle SVG and metadata files retain their previous exact artwork and dimensions. This supersedes the older requirement that None and framed glyphs have identical size. Native X/Y100/100 and rotation0 remain the new None baseline. Revised None glyph awaits owner review; existing frame review status is unchanged.

review.note: Larger native None glyph requested by owner; smaller Square/Circle variants are preserved unchanged. Awaiting owner visual review.
